rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or thinking something in a naive way.

example.english: They naively believed the rumors online.
example.traditional: 佢天真咁相信咗網上面嘅傳聞。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 zan1 gam3 soeng1 seon3 zo2 mong5 soeng6 min6 ge3 cyun4 man4

rows.note: Use this when the naive action also seems silly or foolish, rather than merely innocent or inexperienced.

example.english: They naively posted their bank password online.
example.traditional: 佢傻更更咁將銀行密碼貼咗上網。
example.jyutping: keoi5 so4 gaang1 gaang1 gam3 zoeng1 ngan4 hong4 mat6 maa5 tip3 zo2 soeng5 mong5
